evaluations.evidence: create a new game by entering a name and an optional description
evaluations.rationale: No other story forbids creating games or imposes incompatible constraints on game creation.

evaluations.evidence: invite estimators by giving them a URL where they can access the game
evaluations.rationale: No other story disallows URL-based invitations or requires a mutually exclusive invitation mechanism.

evaluations.evidence: start a round by entering an item in a single multi-line text field
evaluations.rationale: Other stories about items/rounds do not contradict the ability to start a round by entering an item.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: Consistent with other stories that manage and display items; no story restricts visibility of the item list.

evaluations.evidence: select an item to be estimated or re-estimated
evaluations.rationale: Compatible with re-estimation and item list management stories; no conflicting rule about item selection.

evaluations.evidence: add an item to the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: No other story prohibits adding items; aligns with viewing/editing/deleting items.

evaluations.evidence: edit an item in the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: No other story states items are immutable or cannot be edited.

evaluations.evidence: delete an item from the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: No other story requires items to be retained permanently or forbids deletion.

evaluations.evidence: show all estimates immediately ... even though not all estimators have given their estimate
evaluations.rationale: Conflicts with the requirement that estimates are shown only after all estimators have given their estimate to ensure independence.

evaluations.evidence: accept the average of all estimates
evaluations.rationale: No other story forbids using averages or mandates a different exclusive acceptance rule.

evaluations.evidence: filled in automatically if all estimators show the same card
evaluations.rationale: Compatible with manual entry/acceptance; no story prohibits auto-filling when unanimous.

evaluations.evidence: enter the agreed-upon estimate
evaluations.rationale: Coexists with accepting averages and auto-fill; not mutually exclusive.

evaluations.evidence: estimate a story we estimated earlier in the session again
evaluations.rationale: Consistent with item selection/re-estimation (PP-005) and viewing prior rounds; no story forbids re-estimation.

evaluations.evidence: import stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Does not contradict copy/paste or manual entry; multiple ingestion methods can coexist.

evaluations.evidence: copy/paste stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Compatible with importing (PP-014) and manual item creation; no exclusivity stated.

evaluations.evidence: browse through previous games
evaluations.rationale: No other story prevents browsing; deletion stories only remove specific games/accounts.

evaluations.evidence: view a transcript of a game
evaluations.rationale: Consistent with exporting transcripts and browsing previous games; no conflicting access rule stated.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a HTML file
evaluations.rationale: Compatible with viewing transcripts and exporting as CSV; multiple export formats can coexist.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a CSV file
evaluations.rationale: Compatible with HTML export and transcript viewing; no story forbids CSV export.

evaluations.evidence: delete a game, so that stories and estimates for this game are no longer stored
evaluations.rationale: Does not contradict transcript viewing/exporting; those can apply to non-deleted games.

evaluations.evidence: create an account ... name, email address, a password and a username
evaluations.rationale: No other story disallows accounts or mandates a different incompatible identity model.

evaluations.evidence: log in using my account name and password
evaluations.rationale: Consistent with account creation, password reminder, and account changes; no conflicting login method required exclusively.

evaluations.evidence: change my account details
evaluations.rationale: No other story forbids changing account details.

evaluations.evidence: delete my account, so that account information and games are no longer stored
evaluations.rationale: Does not inherently contradict browsing/viewing/exporting; those can apply before deletion or to other accounts.

evaluations.evidence: see dates and times in my local timezone
evaluations.rationale: No other story requires a fixed timezone display.

evaluations.evidence: get a password reminder by email
evaluations.rationale: Compatible with account/login stories; no story forbids email-based reminders.

evaluations.evidence: select whether to have the team estimate with {0, 1/2, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, etc.} or {0, 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, etc.}
evaluations.rationale: No other story mandates a single fixed card sequence; ordering consistency (PP-040) can still hold within the chosen set.

evaluations.evidence: invite up to 15 estimators
evaluations.rationale: No other story requires more than 15 or forbids limiting team size.

evaluations.evidence: join a game by entering my name on the page I received the URL for
evaluations.rationale: Compatible with URL invitations; does not conflict with moderator account login since estimators may join without accounts.

evaluations.evidence: see the item we're estimating
evaluations.rationale: No other story restricts estimators from seeing the current item.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we will try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: Consistent with moderator viewing items (PP-004); no story forbids participants seeing the list.

evaluations.evidence: immediately see that an estimate has been given by a specific estimator
evaluations.rationale: Does not require revealing estimate values; can coexist with hiding actual estimates until reveal.

evaluations.evidence: shown all estimates at the same time after all estimators have given their estimate
evaluations.rationale: Incompatible with the moderator ability to show all estimates immediately before all estimators have estimated.

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate up until the last person selects a card and all are shown
evaluations.rationale: Consistent with the general rule that changes are allowed until completion; aligns with PP-041.

evaluations.evidence: see each estimator's prior estimates for the story being estimated
evaluations.rationale: No other story prohibits showing prior estimates; can be after reveal without contradicting independence for the current draw.

evaluations.evidence: see who gave what estimates during the current round
evaluations.rationale: Compatible with PP-033 if this information is available after reveal; no explicit contradiction stated.

evaluations.evidence: start a two-minute countdown timer that all participants can see
evaluations.rationale: No other story forbids a timer or imposes incompatible timing behavior.

evaluations.evidence: timer reset itself as soon as we all play an estimate
evaluations.rationale: Compatible with starting the timer (PP-037); no conflicting reset rule stated.

evaluations.evidence: scroll back through the stories and estimates from prior rounds
evaluations.rationale: Consistent with transcript viewing and prior estimates visibility; no story forbids access to prior-round info.

evaluations.evidence: always have the cards in the same order across multiple draws
evaluations.rationale: Does not conflict with choosing between two card sets (PP-027); order can be consistent within the selected set.

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate as long as the draw has not been completed
evaluations.rationale: Consistent with PP-034; both allow changes until completion/reveal.

evaluations.evidence: thumbnail photo displayed near where my cards are played
evaluations.rationale: No other story prohibits displaying participant photos or requires anonymity at the UI level.

evaluations.evidence: compliant with XHTML and CSS standards
evaluations.rationale: Compatible with browser support and accessibility requirements; no contradictory technical constraint stated.

evaluations.evidence: list of definitions for commonly used terms
evaluations.rationale: No other story contradicts having a glossary.

evaluations.evidence: created database indexes
evaluations.rationale: No other story forbids indexing or imposes incompatible database constraints.

evaluations.evidence: function correctly in Internet Explorer 6 and 7, Firefox 1.5 and 2, and Safari 2
evaluations.rationale: Compatible with standards compliance and accessibility; no story restricts supported browsers differently.

evaluations.evidence: comply with the W3C accessibility guidelines where possible
evaluations.rationale: No other story imposes an incompatible UI/technical constraint that would directly contradict accessibility compliance.

evaluations.evidence: application respond quickly to my actions
evaluations.rationale: Performance goal does not conflict with other stated requirements.

evaluations.evidence: be able to use Unicode
evaluations.rationale: No other story restricts character sets or mandates ASCII-only behavior.

evaluations.evidence: see sensible and predictable URLs
evaluations.rationale: No other story requires opaque/unpredictable URLs.

evaluations.evidence: nice error pages when something goes wrong
evaluations.rationale: No other story contradicts providing user-friendly error handling.

evaluations.evidence: results to be stored in a non-identifiable way ... e.g., ... "estimator A"
evaluations.rationale: Conflicts with stories requiring identification of specific estimators and their estimates (e.g., showing who estimated and prior estimates per estimator), which implies identifiable linkage of results to individuals.

evaluations.evidence: see some metrics on use of the game
evaluations.rationale: Metrics can be aggregated and does not inherently contradict other requirements (including non-identifiable storage) as stated.
